name: sports-center-emergency
description: 体育中心运动损伤应急处置报告系统（NestJS + Prisma + SQLite + React）

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && rm -rf apps/api/public && cp -r apps/web/dist apps/api/public
